content.comment_body: Hello, Sorry for my English! I'm having trouble downloading my [product_name] program. I get an error message: "Download failed! SD Card file system is not found." My device is compatible with this type of program, and the SD card is inserted. I don't understand why the error persists and would appreciate some help. Thank you!
Why did you create a new topic? You already posted yesterday: [url] Someone responded to your question there.
Thread closed because the question was posted twice. The second topic about 'Download fail SD card' is published in the [product_name] - Software conference. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: A user faces recurring problems downloading a program to their device, specifically receiving an error about the SD card file system not being recognized. The user believes their hardware and SD card are compatible and indicates confusion and frustration due to the lack of clear troubleshooting guidance. Duplicate posts suggest the initial support did not resolve their issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects seamless downloads when using the correct hardware and SD card, and seeks clear instructions or troubleshooting steps to resolve SD card errors.
